name: Eggless Date and Walnut Cake
steps: Warm milk and soak chopped dates for 20 minutes; blend into a thick paste and let cool until lukewarm.
Heat oven to 175°C and line a small loaf tin; whisk oil into the date mixture until combined.
Sift flour, baking powder, soda and cinnamon; fold into the wet mixture, then fold in chopped walnuts.
Bake for 35–40 minutes until a skewer is clean; cool completely before slicing to keep the loaf intact.
tips: Use soft moist dates; very dry dates need longer soaking before blending.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
